items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Me and Edmond Hall stayed. ... Me and Edmond Hall found a place in Brooklyn ... eventually he studied to be a lawyer. And so I used to go and get my breakfast, free breakfast every morning. So Edmond Hall came over on saxophone night, so they heard him.

ctx.x: And I didn't have nothing to go to here. But I didn't go back with them. Me and Edmond Hall stayed.
Did you have any cash in your pocket?
